text:
maya: Quick check — PR #842 (reservation API) is ready for review but I need confirmation on slot mapping vs the new procurement manifest. Procurement ETA shows 2026-07-15, burn-in window 2026-07-18 to 07-22. @sam @liam can you confirm reservation IDs and power schedule?

sam: Procurement ETA matches what I see. One catch: manifest lists 12 H100 nodes but PR currently pins 16 slots. Which do we want to honor?

maya: PR was deliberately conservative to give headroom. If procurement only provides 12 we should change the PR to avoid orchestration rework. Any customer commitments for the extra 4?

anya: Heads-up — Enterprise trial (customer SSO) needs 4 reserved starting 2026-07-25, contract in ENG-4312. That could consume the extra 4.

liam: Runtime note — if we drop to 12 I'll need to change autoscale config (node_pool.max) and the reservation->node mapping. I'll open a follow-up PR and link it.

sam: Also FYI: power window for racking is 2026-07-17 22:00-02:00 UTC (est). Oncall overlap required. @sophia can you take acceptance tests during that window?

sophia: I can take 23:00-01:00 UTC slice. Ping me when racking completes and when the network VLANs are online.

maya: I'll update PR description to call out the manifest id: manifest-resv-2768 and note the conservative slot count. Tagging reviewers @liam @anya — please ack or request changes.

liam: ACK — starting review now.

anya: Quick canary config proposal — keep canary=true, initial_batch=4 for first 24h to limit blast radius. Snippet:
```
canary:
  enabled: true
  initial_batch: 4
  duration: 24h
```

sam: Noted. Procurement team asked that we surface any changes to cooling/rack requirements by 2026-07-10 so they can reorder if needed.

maya: If no objections I'll update the PR to 12 slots, attach the manifest id, and add a short rationale paragraph. Then we'll merge after liam's review. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: PR #842 status: CI passed — unit tests (14), integration smoke passed.

sophia: After merge I'll post a short acceptance runbook and coordinate the test checklist (network, perf smoke, canary traffic).

maya: Action items recap:
- maya: update PR to reflect manifest-resv-2768 and change slots to 12
- liam: open autoscale patch + review PR #842 changes
- anya: add canary job config and test harness changes
- sam: confirm final procurement manifest and raise cooling flags by 2026-07-10 if needed
- sophia: prepare acceptance runbook and cover 23:00-01:00 UTC on racking night

maya: Thanks all — I'll push the PR updates today and ping this thread when done.
